name: virustotal
description: Investigate files, URLs, domains and IP addresses with VirusTotal threat intelligence, analysis and submission recovery.
suggestedPrompts: Check a file I downloaded before I run it. Ask me for its local path, compute SHA-256 without executing it, and look up its existing VirusTotal report. Do not upload it.
Help me assess a suspicious link. Explain what a URL lookup shares before asking for it, then retrieve its existing VirusTotal report. Do not open the link or submit it for analysis.

Investigate an IP address from my logs. Ask for the IP and a brief description of the activity, retrieve its existing VirusTotal report, and explain the evidence and its limits. Do not request a new analysis.
